source_excerpt:
William Parks is a Game Rant editor who specializes in puzzle games, indie releases, Nintendo titles, and completion-focused guide coverage. Since joining Game Rant in 2019, he has written and edited thousands of guides, with much of his work centered on helping players solve specific problems, track down hidden items, and make sense of tricky progression systems.
Before writing about games full time, William worked in arts administration after graduating from the University of Southern California’s School of Cinematic Arts. In that role, he collaborated with curators, artists, and institutions on contemporary exhibitions, an experience that helped shape his careful, research-driven approach to guides. His writing is built around clear structure, close observation, and making complicated objectives easier to follow.
William is especially drawn to games that reward curiosity and experimentation. He approaches guide writing from the perspective of a completionist, with an emphasis on practical advice that gets players where they need to go without wasting their time.
Heroes and Light Advanced is a northwest area in Order of the Sinking Star . It is accessed by opening the HxB gold room , which can be reached after making significant progress in Heroes of Hauling and Vault of the Beamcasters, and teleporting through a laser on Heroes and Light's fifth screen . This walkthrough will help you solve all the puzzles found in Order of the Sinking Star 's Heroes and Light Advanced area.
Instructions that give an unmodified direction (e.g. "move left") mean move one square in that direction. If the direction has a modifier (e.g. "x3"), move that many squares in the indicated direction. If the term "all the way" is used, travel in that direction until you run into a barrier or reach the end of a path.
